name: rotations
description: The three rotations, including an integral angle (Python prints 1.0) and a negative one.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
qc.rx(0.5, 0)
qc.ry(1.5707963267948966, 1)
qc.rz(-3.141592653589793, 0)
qc.rx(1.0, 1)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(2)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.rx(0.5)(q[0]),
    cirq.ry(1.5707963267948966)(q[1]),
    cirq.rz(-3.141592653589793)(q[0]),
    cirq.rx(1.0)(q[1]),
)
